headline: Rent gives a signal not seen in more than four years in Spain
summary: Fotocasa data shows rents fell year on year in July, the first such drop since March 2022. The company says scarce supply means the turn should be read with caution.
why: Fotocasa is a Spanish property portal whose listings data is used to track rental and sales price trends. Rent trends feed into inflation and household-income expectations.

original_headline: El alquiler da una señal que no se veía desde hace más de cuatro años en España
